---
title: Easy Taco Meat
subtitle: A healthy quick weeknight meal
---

This is a simple, semi-homemade meal that makes for a great weeknight dinner.

## Ingredients

Qty | Ingredient
-|-
`1 lb`    | Ground turkey
`1 16 oz` | Jar salsa
`1 16 oz` | Can fat free vegan refried beans

## Process

Brown meat. Add salsa and beans. Cook down.

## Nutrition

4 servings (1 cup): 300 cal, 26 g protein, 30 g carbohydrates (6 g fiber)
